descriptionChirho: Third person feminine plural pronoun hen, appearing only in Biblical Hebrew with prefixed prepositions (bahen 'in/with/by them', mehen 'from/than them', kahen 'like them'). The auto-split clusters simply reflect different prepositional prefixes (bet = in/with/by, min = from/than, kaf = like) rather than distinct senses of the pronoun itself. All occurrences (Gen 19:29, 30:26; Exod 25:29, 37:16; Lev 10:1, 11:21; Num 16:7; Jer 4:29, 48:9, 51:43; Ezek 16:47, 16:52, 18:14) refer anaphorically to feminine plural nouns.
